备注是你给这台设备起的名字，只保存在本机（config.toml），不会发给对端: A note is the name you give this device. It is stored only on this device (config.toml), is never sent to the peer, and doesn't change the peer's own device name. Once set, the device list shows “note(device name)”, while everywhere else (conversation list and titles, tab bar, recipient picker, push cards and notifications) shows just the note; hover a long name to see it in full. A note belongs to the device, not the address — it survives subnet changes and re-pairing. Save with an empty field to clear it.
